My family and I had a great time staying there and we really enjoyed every moment. In fact, it was the best place we stayed during our entire Europe exploration trip. Everyone in the family was very impressed.
We would definitely love to come back again in the future.
Thank you for hosting us!

Tom's place was amazing, the cooking amenities were especially good coming from a 7pax group. It made cooking and cleaning for many really easy for all the days we stayed there. There is a supermarket right down the road within 5mins and is conveniently located 15-20mins away from city center. We also saw the northern lights outside our window on 2 of the nights, which was really really surprising. Overall, everyone loved it and would recommend it to anyone in a big group! We would love to be back some day.

Very well maintained, comfortable and exceptionally well-equipped accommodation. It is also well located, close to the city but in a quiet area.
The beds are very comfortable and we did not lack anything. We were 6 adults and two children, with 2 cars. It's an advantage to have two bathrooms. There are a few games and a sled (shovel) for the children. In the end, they especially loved playing in the snow and ice skating in Charlottenlund.
We would recommend the place.

Group trip
Tom was an outstanding host from the first moment we booked and during our stay. He could not do enough to ensure our trip was the best it could be. His home is beautiful and from the moment we arrived we felt totally at home.
The house itself had everything we needed as a family of 5 and everyone had their own space.
We loved the surrounding gardens that we had lots of snowy fun in, and the 2 minute walk to the supermarket and bus stop was just perfect.
Tromso is a lovely town with lots to do and see and definitely somewhere we would recommend to people.
